page: UpCloud PREMIUM-32xCPU-64GB is a KVM-hypervised virtual server belonging to the Premium family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and features an AMD EPYC 9575F processor operating at 2.0 GHz. The configuration provides 32 vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores with 1.0 thread per core under a shared CPU allocation model. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding 2.0 GB of RAM per core, and includes 400 GB of local SSD storage alongside one complimentary public IPv4 address.

In benchmark evaluations, this server demonstrates top-tier single-core and multi-core performance, achieving top 10% rankings in stress-ng single-core CPU tests and Geekbench single-core and multi-core scores. It also registers strong top 25% performance in multi-core stress-ng, Passmark CPU tests, and database operations, alongside high read-only memory bandwidth. However, memory write bandwidth and static web serving throughput fall into the average tier, and the Passmark memory score is positioned in the bottom 25%, indicating a potential bottleneck for memory-write-intensive tasks.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the server offers a high density of compute resources relative to its memory allocation, making it a viable option for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive RAM footprints. Given its strong CPU performance, database operation capabilities, and fast text and image processing, this server is well-suited for tasks such as software compilation, ray tracing, database hosting, and text processing.
